findings.text: The `frame` demo on /framework/core/Shell/ pushes the whole site in by 192px on the left and right and 32px at the top, because `watch_frame()` writes the `--shell-*` tokens onto `<html>` even for a demo pinned inside a small box (layout 31; flow 26). Evidence: shots/…-core-Shell/1920.png, where the page sits 192px in from both edges (compare shots/…-core/1920.png, where the rail is flush at 0), and layout.json left_stack has an `app` layer of 192px at 1200, 1920 and 3440. The same tokens are what the dev shell writes, so on that page the two fight over them. The demo needs a way to not publish the tokens.

At 400 the dev shell's header is two rows, not the "minimal" thin bar that was asked for (req 1, wrapping 20). DevShell.css hides `.dev-width` below 34em, but that rule is in the `theme` layer and loses to the util-layer `.flex` on the same box. The four size icons and "400px · 29em" still show, and the path is squeezed to "frame". Evidence: worktree dev-shell `public/framework/dev/DevShell/shots/400-open.png`, top band.

At 400 the right-hand sheet covers the bottom 45% of the page, including the site's own bottom rail (… ✦). Nothing reserves that space (`--shell-bottom` only measures the footer). A sheet may cover the page, but it should be one the reader chooses to open (nav 19). Evidence: 400-open.png, lower half.

The docs don't match the code. DevShell readme.md says `new Shell({ frame: true, dark: true, … })`, but the code uses `dark: ["head","left","right","foot"]` on purpose. DevShell doc/decisions.md says the left side "calls every section in the page tab", but the code picks only `route` and `structure` by name (words 7).

"Scrap most of the dev bar's CSS" (req 2) is only partly done. devbar.css is untouched because v1 has to keep working, and the dev shell's panels still lean on it through the borrowed `dev-body` class. This is acceptable until v1 is retired; it is worth saying so in the landing report.

/framework/dev/DevShell/ at 3440 is one narrow column: its three proof shots are stacked full-width images down a 706px measure, so most of the screen is empty (layout 1). Evidence: shots/…-dev-DevShell/sheet.png, and `empty` 0.77 at 3440.

log.msg: Review answers: 1 fixed (Shell publish:false for a demo frame; core/Shell page no longer pushes the site). 2 fixed (phone rule moved to @layer util; 400 head is one line, shot 400-open.png). 3 declined: at 400 the sheet covers the page's lower half, but the reader opened it on purpose with Ctrl+\ and closes it the same way. 4 fixed (readme + decisions.md match the code). 5 kept: devbar.css stays while v1 must work; retire it with v1. 6 declined for now: the DevShell page's stacked shots at 3440 are a small doc page, not a tool.

Bands at 400/1920/3440 (dev shell open on /framework/core/Page/): head one line at all three; left 288px dark tree at 1920/3440, hidden at 400; page pushed 288px each side, nothing covered; right rail flush at the edge; footer one line. Zero console errors.
